        A note on the math ＋

        Original net mesos = (ending mesos − starting mesos) − (HP used × HP cost) − (MP used × MP cost).

        Every rate uses active time, excluding paused breaks and ending-value entry. Negative gains and losses are preserved. Add starting and ending levels for automatic level-up EXP, using the MeowDB Classic table through level 100.

        Adjusted cash adds uncounted income and subtracts uncounted expenses. Estimated total additionally includes unsold loot. Keep anything already included in the balance out of the ledger.

        Use one distinct supply per slot. Count mixed HP/MP potions in one slot only. Map comparisons are time-weighted averages of your filtered history; party size, buffs, and gear are not normalized.
